system:
Write one original, complete, candidate-only harness package for the supplied focused task method.
The host owns identity, effect permissions, file paths, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
Answer in the original_native_file_blocks/v2 format and nothing else. The answer has exactly this shape:
<<<DRAFT>>>
record_type: original_native_file_blocks/v2
method_id: the supplied method identity
<<<planned/path.ext>>>
the complete file content, exactly as the file should read
<<<END planned/path.ext>>>
<<<END DRAFT>>>
Write one block for every planned file, in any order, between the header and the END DRAFT line.
Every marker stands alone on its own line. Write every planned path exactly once and no other path.
Write file contents as plain text exactly as they should be saved: never escape quotes, backslashes or
newlines, never wrap a file in quotes, and never write a line that starts with <<< and ends with >>> inside a file.
Write nothing outside the markers except blank lines: no Markdown fence, no commentary.
Contents are UTF-8 text, never base64. Do not return digests, approval claims, credentials or executable downloads.
Write complete useful implementations and native entrypoint instructions, not placeholders.
Link supplied helpers and contracts from the entrypoint. Preserve bounded work and explicit refusals.
The supplied source references are provenance for task discovery, not claims that those sources implement your new method.
Do not copy opportunity-source wording into generated files; write original method instructions.
Do not execute anything. All generated material still requires independent review and qualification.
